correctness.rationale: In odd characteristic with \(q\equiv2\pmod3\), the separable cubic \(h(t)=t^3+t^2+at+b\) controls the ten branch points of \(xh(x^3)\). A rational cubic root lifts to one fixed point plus a 2-cycle; a quadratic Frobenius pair lifts to either three 2-cycles or one 6-cycle depending on cubic residuosity in \(\mathbb F_{q^2}\); an irreducible cubic lifts to one 3-cycle and one 6-cycle. The discriminant-zero count gives \(q^2-2q+2\) smooth marked parameters. Exact inclusion-exclusion counts split cubics, and the trace-of-cubes polynomial \(2u(u^2+3dv^2)\), with three rational linear factors, gives cubic-residue counts \((q-1)/2\) for zero trace and \((q-5)/6\) otherwise; the quadratic trace is \(-(1+r)\), so its zero case is \(r=-1\). These establish all four frequency polynomials, not merely examples. Because the zero branch point is rational, Frobenius-invariant even subsets modulo complementation give \(\lvert J[2](\mathbb F_q)\rvert=2^{c-2}\), proving 32,16,4,2. Two standalone exact arithmetic programs independently enumerated branch cycles and trace fibers for primes 5,11,17,23,29,41; exhaustive finite tests corroborate the proof but are not used as infinite certification.

originality.rationale: The initiating Kudo–Nakagawa–Takagi work gives this curve family, automorphisms and superspeciality algorithms, not the four Frobenius spectra or parameter frequency formulae. Detailed characteristic-seven, -eleven and -seventeen arithmetic studies of this family concern Hasse/Cartier ranks and Jacobian Weil polynomials. A closely related result for \(y^2=x^{10}+ux^7+vx^4+x\) over \(q\equiv1\pmod3\) classifies five branch types in a disjoint field regime; it does not imply the present cubic-trace treatment for \(q\equiv2\pmod3\). The distinct Bruin–Kulkarni Jacobian-square family has a four-type Frobenius classification based on quadratic lifting but is not the current family. The 2025 work on paired quadratic/cubic irreducibility counts a different parametrized polynomial pair, and its cubic counting techniques are not claimed novel. Searches for the explicit displayed polynomial, parameter frequencies and cubic-residue formulation revealed no statement dominating the claimed theorem. This is a best-knowledge priority judgment, not a proof of uniqueness of publication.

value.rationale: The geometric hyperelliptic branch locus and Jacobian two-torsion are canonical arithmetic structures central to genus-four descent and isogeny questions. This theorem solves the complete finite-field factorization-frequency problem for a natural entire smooth cyclic-six two-parameter family, instead of computing sporadic instances: it gives the four exact types, their nonzero frequencies, minimal splitting degrees and all rational \(2\)-torsion orders. A genuine cubic-residue trace dichotomy beyond the \(q\equiv1\pmod3\) case is needed. Coefficient-marked counts, rather than claims about moduli classes, are deliberately and naturally specified. No downstream application beyond these exact arithmetic invariants is asserted.
